step: Last season's target alone (year over year r squared)
note: Squared correlation between a forward's target this season and last season. This is the number to beat.

step: Style scores + team style features + last season's target
note: Single run. Baseline before linemates and competition were added.

step: Add top two linemates' style scores and quality of competition
note: Gain of +0.123 over the baseline. Across 20 seeds the gain averaged +0.120 (std 0.019, range +0.080 to +0.159) and was positive on every seed.

step: Add last season's ice time, age, zone starts, linemate prior pairings
note: 20 seed mean. Up from 0.389. Small gain, mostly from zone starts.

step: Shooter score changed to shots on goal + team-blended high danger chances
note: Old shooter score (3 stats including finishing luck) was 0.404. Gain of +0.039.

step: Team blend on or off
note: Raw stats scored 0.4314. The blend lowered year to year repeatability on all 13 stats tested but still helped the model by +0.012.

step: Drop carries with chances rate from transition score
note: Very low year to year repeatability (r = 0.13). A scratch test on the earlier feature set gave 0.4485.

step: Also drop neutral zone assists from transition score
note: Scored higher in a scratch test but I kept the stat because it is stable (r = 0.33) and the score felt incomplete without it.

step: Add forecheck and cycle score (pressures + recoveries)
note: +0.0029, mostly a tighter spread across seeds.

step: Add net front score (deflections, deflection assists, rebounds)
note: +0.0097. Rebound assists left out, same low repeatability problem as carries with chances.

step: Add skating speed from NHL Edge (own + linemates)
note: -0.0031. Stats are very repeatable year to year but add nothing for this target.

step: Speed with 6 different multi-season weightings
note: Scores ranged from 0.4577 to 0.4600, all inside the seed noise. 5/4/3 weighting was best at 0.4600, still no better than no speed at all (0.4597).

step: Speed trend over last 3 seasons (own + linemates)
note: More than a third of players have fewer than 2 prior seasons of Edge data, so the feature is mostly missing.

step: Speed trend, own player only
note: Same missing data problem.

step: Add height and weight
note: -0.0007. A single seed run showed 0.4913 which looked like a gain. The 20 seed average did not.

step: Add defense partner composite (top 6 D partners by time together)
note: +0.0024, inside the noise. Kept because the spread across seeds got tighter (0.0148 to 0.0107). That is a judgment call.

step: Shot volume minus shot quality as one tilt feature
note: -0.0172 against the 0.4597 baseline.

step: Shot volume and shot quality as two separate features
note: -0.0130. Averaging the two worked better than giving the trees both.

step: Add pace of play (zone entries for and against)
note: -0.0034, no signal.

step: Team style features for predicting ixG per 60 (switchers)
note: R squared change of +0.0208 when team style features were added. Small but consistent.

step: Team style features for predicting assists per 60 (switchers)
note: R squared change of -0.0132. Team style made assist predictions worse for players who changed teams.

step: Predicting the biggest swings in assists per 60
note: Three attempts (case study, looser settings, quantile bands) all failed. The models shrink toward the average and miss the extreme cases.

step: Earlier version: predict RAPM from microstats + team system stats
note: Team system stats added nothing beyond a player's own RAPM history. This is why the model was rebuilt.
